summary: A member asks whose opposition a letter represents when a citizens’ group uses the town’s name.
realLife: In the Maine islands discussion, staff distinguished the Friends of Castine from the town government and its appointed naming committee.
inGame: needs: the signers of the objection and their relationship to the town government.

turns.pulledBy: The letter comes from a residents’ group.
turns.writesBack: The record attributes the objection to that group..

turns.pulledBy: The select board adopts its own position.
turns.writesBack: The file now has an official town recommendation..
